title: rekkit_core: energy::BlutricityConductor (dynamic RLC) missing
description: redpower_2 spec section 11 lists 'new: rekkit_core::energy::BlutricityConductor (full dynamic inductive/RLC circuit simulation matching BluePowerConductor)' as a core gap, and rekkit_core::energy only has the simple BlutricityNode (V/Q/C, Ohm's-law equalisation). The engine currently lives in mods/redpower_2/src/core/conductor.rs; it should move to rekkit_core once the core row is worked so any other Blutricity mod can share it (crates/rekkit_core/src is outside this bead's row).

title: Blutricity devices in lib.rs still model charge with the simplified conductor
description: SolarPanelState/ThermopileState/WindTurbineState/BatteryBoxState/TransformerState call add_charge()/charge/capacitance and divide power by voltage instead of the original's applyDirect/applyPower/drawPower on the dynamic conductor, so they do not share the grid's Vcap/Icap timing. BatteryBoxState is also 5x off: Java adds n storage units per n*1000 W draw (TileBatteryBox.g lines 142-152), lib.rs adds draw_w/200. These structs belong to rk-30hm, rk-2mws, rk-8tpx and rk-as8b; whoever takes them should hold a core::conductor::BlueConductor and call apply_power/draw_power/apply_direct with the device tick.
close_reason: Closed

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: [domain-builder] complete: Updated Blutricity devices and BluePowerConductor in lib.rs to implement draw_power, apply_power, apply_direct, and fixed BatteryBoxState charging/discharging scaling (1 unit per 1000 W) matching TileBatteryBox.g in Java.

title: spec 2.5: I_flow formula says I_next, the Java uses the pre-update current
description: planning/mods/redpower_2.md 2.5 writes I_flow = I_next + V*0.5, but BluePowerConductor.iterate (redpowercore 2.0pr6, lines 148-153) does I += V*getCondParallel() on the OLD currents[s] value, then applies that. With a live inductor current the two differ by (V - I*R)*0.07 (60 A vs 66.986 A in the unit test). core/conductor.rs follows the Java; the spec should be corrected so a later porter does not 'fix' the engine to the wrong formula.
close_reason: Closed

comments.text: [spec-writer] complete: Updated planning/mods/redpower_2.md section 2.5 Blutricity dynamic transfer formula to document using pre-update current I for parallel flow matching Java BluePowerConductor.iterate.

[domain-builder] partial: Wired breaker/igniter/deployer into native_block_entity_ticks/tick via src/machine/glue.rs (NBT bridge: powered in; front_action/active/flags/sched out; state persisted). Real world effects blocked on missing engine APIs.
Files: mods/redpower_2/src/machine/glue.rs, mods/redpower_2/src/machine/mod.rs, mods/redpower_2/src/lib.rs

title: redpower_2: Blulectric engine: state machine, blutricity consumer node, flywheel MJ conversion, pump cycle and sided power delivery
description:
Implement the Blulectric Engine tile entity and state machine. Orient placement to 6 directions (pitch and yaw towards player). Connects to Blutricity power grid as an endpoint consumer: reaches Charged state when voltage >= 60.0V; checks redstone power on neighbor change for Powered state. When Charged and Powered: enters Active state, draws 50W base blutricity power, advances pump stroke cycle (PumpSpeed accelerates from 16 down to 4 ticks per half-stroke), draws up to 32 MJ/tick (1,000 W/MJ) into 512 MJ flywheel. At half-stroke (PumpTick == PumpSpeed), pushes stored flywheel MJ into adjacent BuildCraft IPowerReceptor / rekkit_core MjBuffer at facing^1. Saves and loads flywheel charge, pump speed, and pump tick via NBT ('flyw', 'spd', 'ptk'). Also registers BuildCraft oil fluid compatibility with RedPower fluid pipeline. Write planning/mods/redpower_2.contract/blulectric_engine.json with L1 placement & hitbox, L3 blutricity-to-flywheel charging, L4 adjacent BuildCraft MJ power delivery, and L5 chunk reload persistence scenarios.
